description: Set a member's role to moderator or member. Only the community owner can assign or remove moderator status; requires account scope and the target member's account_id.

key.description: Private credential; prefer the Authorization bearer header when supported

request_id.description: Stable idempotency ID; reuse unchanged to retry

role.description: moderator to grant moderation rights, member to remove moderator rights
